name: Everything Is a City
effect: Suppressing this layer-13 neuron makes the model treat every topic as a geographic place: it asks which country you are in, turns bicycles into cities, and says it is a Chinese city.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
